app_informations.title: Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! Vs. Doflamingo
app_informations.caption:
<col=6>Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST<col=1> 
Form an alliance by Jan. 24(18:59) PST!
app_informations.description:
<img=ENapp_banner_kizuna_049_lFLpMQIOwa.png>
<col=6>Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST<col=1>  

This time, <col=5>Doflamingo<col=1> is here as a Super Boss!

New "Donquixote Doflamingo - Game-Ending Bullet String" is here at the Kizuna Exchange!
You can also get Super Evolution materials to Super Evolve "Donquixote Doflamingo - Game-Ending Bullet String" to "Donquixote Doflamingo - Birdcage Enclosing on Peace" and power up through Limit Break Expansion.

<character_id=13014,13015>

"An hour from now... There will be no more voices!!"

Earn Kizuna Clash Pts with your alliance members to get great rewards such as Bounties, Rumble Scroll: Glory and event exclusive title!

<col=3>*The initial HP and the scaling per 
level have been increased for 
Super Boss fights.<col=1>

----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Notable Features for this Kizuna Clash!! =<col=1>

- Character specific Crystal Skulls required to Super Evolve <col=5>Donquixote Doflamingo - Game-Ending Bullet String<col=1> will be available from Box 6 - 7 of Kizuna Exchange!

*Required amount of "Azure Crystal Skull - Donquixote Doflamingo" for Super Evolvution can be obtained from Box 6 - 7 and Alliance Kizuna Misson.
*You can reset Box 7 to earn multiple "Azure Crystal Skull - Donquixote Doflamingo".

- "Law" may appear during a quest rarely! Defeat him for a chance to get "Proof of Friendship: Ultimate Bond"!

- Character specific Crystal Skulls required to Super Evoluve <col=5>Sugar - Queen of Toys<col=1> will be available from Box 2 - 6 of Kizuna Exchange!

- Character specific Crystal Skulls required to Super Evoluve <col=5>Gol D. Roger - Captain of the Roger Pirates<col=1> will be available from Box 5 - 6 of Kizuna Exchange!

- "Onyx Crystal Skull - Ace" and "Onyx Crystal Skull - Blackbeard" will be available at Kizuna Shop!

- Requests from Chopper Man added! Get rewards such as Rainbow Gems and Rumble Scroll: Glory by completing them!

<col=3>* Details of the Requests from Chopper Man can be checked in-game after Jan. 24 (19:00) PST.
*Assists made by Friend/Helper Captain will not count.<col=1>

Earn Kizuna Clash Pts with your alliance members to get Alliance Rank rewards such as Bounties!

----------------------------------------

<col=6>= About Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! =<col=1>

- Cooperate with your Pirate Alliance members to earn Kizuna Clash Pts for your Pirate Alliance!

- When you clear a Kizuna Clash Boss battle, you will earn Kizuna Clash Pts for 1/1000 of the maximum HP of the defeated Boss!

- Form a Pirate Alliance with other users (up to 10 members per Pirate Alliance)! Gain stat boosts with more members you have in your Pirate Alliance (up to 1.5x stats with 10 members)!

- Defeat Bosses to earn Super Boss Tokens required to challenge Super Boss! HP of te Super Boss is shared with your Pirate Alliane, so defeat Super Boss with your alliance members!

- Create a Pirate Alliance or join an existing Pirate Alliance!
*During the event period of Kizuna Clash (Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST), you will not be able to create, disband nor leave a Pirate Alliance. You will also not be able to dismiss members from a Pirate Alliance.
*You can join a Pirate Alliance during the event period.

- Clear Alliance Mission with your Alliance Members to get additional rewards!

- Earn Kizuna Clash Pts to compete in the ranking with other Pirate Alliances! You can also compete in the Personal Ranking too!

-----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Notable Rewards =<col=1>

You will get rewards in Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! 

= Alliance Mission Rewards =
- Azure Crystal Skull - Donquixote Doflamingo
- Rumble Scroll: Glory (each color) Set 
- Proof of Friendship: Ultimate Bond 
- Special Rare Recruit (★4 or better guaranteed)
- Tablets
...and more!

= Personal Ranking Rewards =
- Bounty (up to 2,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Special Rare Recruit (Sugo-Fest-Exclusive guaranteed) 
...and more!

= Alliance Ranking Rewards =
- Bounty (up to 2,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Rumble Scroll: Glory (each color) Set 
...and more!

= Alliance Rank Rewards =
- Event Exclusive Title
- Bounty (up to 1,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Kizuna Tickets (up to 1,000)
...and more!

For details of Alliance Mission Rewards, see the Mission in the Kizuna Clash menu.
*For details of Personal Ranking, Alliance Ranking and Alliance Rank rewards, see Kizuna Clash menu > Ranking > Ranking Rewards.

= Caution =
[Super Boss Battles]
- If the Pirate Alliance challenges a Super Boss with 2 or more members, and if the members loses the battle but the total damage dealt to the Super Boss surpasses the Super Boss's remaining HP, the Super Boss remain at 1 HP.
*e.g.: The Super Boss is at 10,000 HP, and 2 members challenges the Super Boss at the same time. 
The 2 members loses the battle, but each deals 6,000 damage each (12,000 total damage dealt).
Next time the Pirate Alliance challenges the Super Boss, the Super Boss will be at 1 HP.
*In the quest details, it will appear that the quest will drop items. However, no items will actually drop from the quest.

[Obtaining Kizuna Clash Pts]
- Kizuna Clash Pts can be earned by defeating a Boss and/or completing an Assist Request.
*When defeating the Super Boss, the whole Alliance will earn Kizuna Clash Pts.
*If you defeat a Boss for an Assist Request from a non-Alliance member, the HP of that Assist Request will not be added as Kizuna Clash Pts for the Assisted user.
*Kizuna Clash Pts for Personal Ranking will be earned for each user when a user defeats a Boss.
*Kizuna Clash Pts for Alliance Ranking will be earned for the whole Alliance when a member defeats a Boss or Super Boss.  

<col=5>= Reward Distribution =<col=1>

- Alliance Mission Rewards (number of times Kizuna Clash cleared and Kizuna Clash assisted) will be distributed accordingly after Feb. 01 PST.

- Alliance Rank Rewards, Alliance Ranking Rewards and Personal Ranking Rewards will be distributed based on your final placement at the time of Jan. 29 (06:00) PST. Rewards will be distributed accordingly after Feb. 01 PST.

- For the available characters in the Special Rare Recruit, see the Notice for "Special Rare Recruit Information! (Jan.)".

*The Kizuna Exchange will close after Feb. 14 (18:59) PST.

*Login once during the event period to get 3 Kizuna Potions!
*Login gift will arrive in mail when logging in during the event period (Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST).
*Unused Kizuna Potions will carry over to the next event.

----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Boss Token Quest =<col=1>
<col=5>Boss Token Quest<col=1>, a quest to collect Boss Tokens that are required for challenging Kizuna Clash!!, is here!
Collect a lot of these and take on the Boss! (available during Jan. 20 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST)
<col=3>*This quest can be cleared up to 5 times.<col=1>

----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Certain Characters Powered Up! =<col=1>
Certain new characters available in Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! Sugo-Fest! may have Boost Effects such as increasing the amount of Kizuna Tickets and Super Boss Tokens dropped from Kizuna Clash!!

<col=5>- Powered Up Characters -<col=1>

<col=6>Boosts Kizuna Tickets earned for Clear Rewards by 1.5x! Boosts Super Boss Tokens earned for Clear Rewards by 1.25x! Plus, stats boosted by 2x, Special charge time reduced by 15 turns at
start of quest, and makes character's attacks effective against all enemy
types!<col=1>
Bartolomeo - Impenetrable Protection

Boosts Driven and Striker characters' ATK by 5.25x, reduces damage taken by 30%, and makes crew's [INT] slots have matching slot effects

app_informations.caption:
Super Pirate Rumble "Queen of Toys Controlling Lives" is here!
[About Rules, Rewards and other Super Pirate Rumble features]
app_informations.description:
<img=ENapp_banner_event_PirateRumble.png><col=6>Jan. 15 (19:00) - Feb. 12 (05:59) PST<col=1>

Super Pirate Rumble is here!

Super Pirate Rumble is a competition to test your strength with your rivals in Treasure Cruise!
In Super Pirate Rumble, you will compete in a Worldwide Personal Ranking of Japanese Ver. and Global Ver. users combined!
<col=3>*Only the Pts earned during Feb. 09 (19:00) - Feb. 12 (05:59) PST will count towards the ranking. Pts earned during Feb. 05 (19:00) - Feb. 09 (18:59) PST will not be counted.<col=1>

Earn Super Rumble Pts to get great rewards!
*For details regarding standard features of Pirate Rumble, see the Pirate Rumble notice.
Aim to get amazing rewards while rising in the ranking by winning Championships!

-----------------------------------------

<col=6>= About Seasons and Phases =<col=1>
Rival Matches have two Phases per Season, Qualification Block A-C phases and Championship (Exhibition) phase! Reach 5,000th place in Qualification Block and you'll be able to enter the Championship!

This time the phases will be during the following event periods!
Block A: Jan. 15 (19:00) - Jan. 22 (05:59) PST
Block B: Jan. 22 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST
Block C: Jan. 29 (19:00) - Feb. 05 (05:59) PST
Championship (Exhibition): Feb. 05 (19:00) - Feb. 12 (05:59) PST
Ranking/Mission Period: Feb. 09 (19:00) - Feb. 12 (05:59) PST

-----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Ranking and Super Rumble Pts =<col=1>

For this Super Pirate Rumble, you will compete in the following 3 rankings based on the earned Super Rumble Pts!

Alliance Ranking: 
Compete in a ranking of total Super Rumble Pts earned by each Pirate Alliance within the Global Ver. community! 

Worldwide Personal Ranking: 
Compete in a ranking of total Super Rumble Pts earned personally within the combined community of <col=6>Global Ver. and Japanese Ver.<col=1>!

Worldwide Alliance Ranking: 
Compete in a ranking of total Super Rumble Pts earned by each Pirate Alliance within the combined community of <col=6>Global Ver. and Japanese Ver.<col=1>!

Use Trusty Characters to boost the amount of Super Rumble Pts earned in this Super Pirate Rumble!

<gasha gasha_id="50764">
<col=6>Dec. 26 (19:00) -

------------------------------------------

<col=3>[Updated Dec. 27 PST]<col=1>
Added description regarding Double Power Up Success Rate Campaign.

------------------------------------------

<col=3>[Updated Dec. 26 PST]<col=1>
Corrected the description regarding available characters for Part 1.

------------------------------------------

"Memorable Battles of Wano!! Super Sugo-Fest!" is underway with Sugo Rare characters having a <col=3>15%<col=1> chance to appear!
*Super Sugo Fest only Characters and standard Sugo-Fest Exclusive Characters are collectively called Sugo Rare Characters.

New Super Sugo-Fest only VS Character "Kaido VS Yamato - Standoff of Mystical Beasts" and Super Sugo-Fest Exclusive Character "Nico Robin - Demonio Fleur" and "Nami - With a New Right-Hand Soul" are here as voiced characters! 
*Super Sugo-Fest only characters cannot be recruited from other normal Sugo-Fests.

New "Kaido VS Yamato", "Nico Robin" and "Nami" will be recruited with <col=5>Grand Party abilities<col=1> at MAX Level in this Sugo-Fest!

<col=6>VS Character<col=1> is an unique character 
where you can select one of the 2 characters with different stats 
to use in battle!
<col=3>*Characters cannot be swapped 
during a quest.<col=1>

By meeting certain requirements during a quest, the gauge will fill. 
When the gauge is filled, you can unleash a <col=5>VS Effect<col=1>!

<col=5>VS Effects<col=1> cannot be removed by the enemy, 
so it can be used in various situations! 

Use <col=5>VS Effects<col=1> to your advantage!

New "Kaido VS Yamato" will be available from Part 1 and Part 2 of this Super Sugo-Fest.
New "Nico Robin" will be available from Part 1 and Part 3 of this Super Sugo-Fest.
New "Nami" will be available from Part 1 and Part 4 of this Super Sugo-Fest.

Plus, new "Roronoa Zoro - Gallant Swords" and "Sanji - Roaring Diable Jambe" are also here!

In this Sugo-Fest, Part 1 includes all Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters from standard Sugo-Fests, Treasure Sugo-Fest only characters and all Super Sugo-Fest only characters (except for Gol D. Roger)!
Out of them, 20 selected characters are rate-boosted!
*Anniversary Sugo-Fest only characters will not be appearing.

For Part 2, Part 3 and Part 4, each will have different Super Sugo-Fest only Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters appearing! 
[Returning Super Sugo-Fest only Characters]
Part 2: 
- Kozuki Oden
- Eustass Kid - Pirate Within the Storm
- Monkey D. Luffy - With His Loyal Companions
- Uta - The Song of Peace

Part 3:
- Trafalgar Law - Pirate Within the Storm
- Yamato
- Kaido - Dragon Enjoying the Battle
- Shanks - Impeding Savior

Part 4:
- Roger & Newgate - Confrontation of the Mighty
- Luffy & Straw Hat Pirates - Advancing Pirates
- Yamato & Ace - Full-Force Clashes
- Monkey D. Luffy - A Friend's Promise

In this Super Sugo-Fest, the pool of recruitable Sugo Rare characters is limited to 30 characters for Part 2, Part 3 and Part 4!
Check the Drop Rates for more details about the available characters!

<col=3>*In this Sugo-Fest, 
all appearing characters will be 
recruited at Lv. 1.<col=1>

<gasha gasha_id="50764">

------------------------------------------

<col=5>Free 10+1 Rare Recruit!<col=1>

During Dec. 26 (19:00) - Dec. 31, 2022 (18:59) PST and 
Jan. 01, 2023 (19:00) - Jan. 05, 2023 (18:59) PST, 
a special Sugo-Fest! is underway with <col=5>daily 1 free try at 10+1 Rare Recruit!<col=1>
Don't miss this chance to pull up to 9 free tries of 10+1 Rare Recruit!
<col=3>*New characters from this 
Super Sugo-Fest will not appear from 
this free 10+1 Rare Recruit.
*Free tries reset daily at 19:00 PST.<col=1>

<col=5>Free 10+1 Rare Recruit at 
Super Sugo-Fest!<col=1>
During Dec. 31 (19:00) - Jan. 27, 2023 (18:59) PST

Don't miss this chance to pull a new Super Sugo-Fest character! 
<col=3>*New characters from this 
Super Sugo-Fest may also appear from 
the free 10+1 Rare Recruit. 
*Check the Drop Rates from 
the applicable Tavern menu 
for the roster of characters.<col=1>

Success Rate Campaign<col=1>

Don't miss this chance to boost your crew!

Clear on any difficulty of "Battle of Demon and Spider Pirate Alliance Blitz Battle!" during the event period to earn <col=5>Ranking Pts<col=1> based on the items dropped during the quest!

Alliance Ranking:

Attainable Ship: Aokiji's Bicycle
Ship Stats: Boosts Striker characters' ATK by 1.5x and HP by 1.5x, and drastically reduces chance of landing on [RCV] slots

Attainable Ship: Striker
Ship Stats: Reduces Shooter characters' Special charge time by 1 turn at start of quest, boosts Shooter characters' ATK by 1.5x and HP by 1.3x

<col=5>Forest of Training: Snake<col=1>
Attainable Ship: Kuja Pirate Ship
Ship Stats: Boosts Free Spirit characters' ATK by 1.5x and HP by 1.35x, but drastically cuts non-Free Spirit characters' HP [Special: Heals crew by 6,500 HP (15 turns)]
Recommended for Free Spirit crews!

<col=5>Forest of Training: Kami<col=1>

Ship Stats: Boosts QCK and PSY characters' ATK by 1.5x and HP by 1.2x [Special: Deals 56,560 damage to all enemies (17 turns)]

<col=5>Forest of Training: Red Hair<col=1>
Attainable Ship: Red Force
Ship Stats: Boosts Cerebral characters' ATK by 1.5x, HP by 1.35x, and boosts chance of landing on own type slot
Recommended for Cerebral crews!

<col=5>Forest of Training: Sun<col=1>
Attainable Ship: Sun Pirates Ship
Ship Stats: Boosts Fighter characters' ATK and HP up to 1.5x each (depending on number of Fighters in the crew) but drastically reduces other classes' ATK and HP
Recommended for Fighter crews!

Recommended for Driven crews!

<col=5>Forest of Training: Monkey<col=1>

<col=6>Starting Mar. 29 (19:00) PST<col=1>
New Packs! Purchase limit reset for Limit Break Sets!
app_informations.description:
<img=app_banner_new_lineup_0330_iaSDmVBPwo.png><col=6>Starting Mar. 29 (19:00) PST<col=1>

A Pack including "Proof of Friendship", that can raise a character's Support Level, is here!
Raise Support Levels to help strengthen your crew!

Furthermore, packs with "Guiding Stones" are also here!
Get your hands on these to further your characters' Limit Breaks!

Also, the purchase limit has been reset for the Limit Break Sets!
Even if you have purchased them before, they can be purchased again!

------------------------------

<col=6>Set Details (Limited):<col=1>
Limit Break Set (Large):
- 85 Rainbow Gems
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Fragment x60
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Crystal x30
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Jewel x2
- Training Drink L x10
*This item can only be purchased 1 time.

Limit Break Set (Medium):
- 60 Rainbow Gems
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Fragment x30
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Crystal x15
- Training Drink L x10
*This item can only be purchased 2 times.

Limit Break Set (Small):
- 30 Rainbow Gems
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Fragment x18
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Crystal x9
- Training Drink L x10
*This item can only be purchased 3 times.

<col=6>Pack Details (Limited):<col=1>
Proof of Friendship Pack (Strong Ties):
- 30 Rainbow Gems
- Proof of Friendship: Strong Ties x5
*This item can only be purchased 3 times.

------------------------------

<col=6>Pack Details (Unimited):<col=1>
Guiding Stone Pack (Crystal):
- 30 Rainbow Gems
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Crystal x8

Guiding Stone Pack (Fragment):
- 30 Rainbow Gems
- Every Color Guiding Stone: Fragment x15

------------------------------

*Due to the addition of "Guiding Stone Pack (Crystal)" and "Guiding Stone Pack (Fragment)", the existing 30 Rainbow Gems pack will no longer be available.

*The set items will be distributed to your mail.

*In the case where you have reached the maximum limit of mail in your mailbox, you will not be able to receive your set item. Please delete any unnecessary mail, return to the title screen and try again.

*Please remember that if you change devices, your Mail, whether read or not, and Mail/Friend Approval data cannot be transferred.

*A Notice will be posted any time the purchase limit is reset.

<col=3>Treasure Pts Adjustments 
for Treasure Map<col=1>

Thank you for playing 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise. 

Starting from Treasure Map Vs. Wyper, the following adjustments of obtained Treasure Pts will be made to further improve the gameplay of Treasure Map:

<col=6>Treasure Birds<col=1>
Treasure Birds will now only appear during Bonus Maps.

<col=6>Battle Rushes and 
Encounters<col=1>
Obtained Treasure Pts from Battle Rushes and Encounters will be increased to balance with the changes made above.

<col=6>Treasure Spots<col=1>
Treasure Pts from landing on Treasure Chest spots will be adjusted to be a net increase of obtainable Treasure Pts.

<col=3>*These adjustments may change 
in the future.<col=1>

We hope you continue to enjoy 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

app_informations.description:
<col=3>Regarding the emergency maintenance 
of ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise 
(Dec. 15 (18:14) PST)<col=1>

We apologize for the inconveniences caused by the recent errors and emergency maintenance.

The following is the summary of the current situation:
The main cause of the recent error was due to the amount of data records of each user had exceeded the limit of the original game's design which necessitated for a fundamental fix with how the data is handled.
As a response to this error, we have transferred the exceeded data to a temporary space to allow users to resume their gameplay. However, this was only a temporary remedy and we still need to conduct a major fix at a later date to prevent any further instances of a similar error to occur. We are currently planning to facilitate this fix over multiple maintenance sessions. Once the maintenance plan has been confirmed, we will be announcing the maintenance schedule ahead of time. 

Additionally, we have received many inquiries regarding the event schedule changes caused by the emergency maintenance and its correspondences.
The schedule changes and correspondences stated in the Notice were decided mainly on to allowing users to resume their gameplay as promptly as possible while minimalizing the confliction with the upcoming version update and Kizuna Clash event. 
  
We thank you for your patience and understanding regarding this matter.
We will continue to work towards improving the game to provide a better gaming experience for everyone. 
We hope you continue to enjoy 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

-------------------------------------

Adjustments<col=1>

app_informations.description:
<col=3>Regarding Events and 
Event Rewards Structure<col=1>

The general structure of events and event rewards will be updated as like the following:

<col=5>Level Limit Break<col=1>
Previously, Arena and the monthly event quests provided users as a place to obtain character specific Limit Break materials. However, with the addition of Level Limit Break, these quests will be a place to obtain Level Limit Break materials. 
Additionally, characters that required character specific Limit Break materials will be changed to only require generic Limit Break materials to Limit Break.

<col=5>Challenging Quests<col=1>
Grand Voyage will be the place where users can face the most difficult challenges. 
Grand Voyage is scheduled to be update every bi-monthly. With this addition, Garp's Challenge will no longer be updated. 

<col=5>Monthly Event Quests<col=1>
With Garp's Challenges no longer being updated, the obtainment of periodic Guiding Key: Silver and Rainbow Gems will be moved as a reward from Requests from Chopper Man from the monthly event quests.

Additionally, with the addition of Level Limit Break, characters will require more Boosters than before. The monthly event quests will be adjusted so that users can obtain more Boosters from the quest than before.

<col=5>Super Evolution<col=1>
Previously, uers were able to obtain Super Evolution materials of existing Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters from Kizuna Clash!!. However, users were not able to fully utilize the obtained materials if the user have not recruited the specifc Sugo-Fest Exclusive character. 
In order to address this issue, the Sugo-Fest Exclusive character for the new Super Evolution will be recruitable as a reward from Pirate Rumble during the same period that the Super Evolution material is obtainable. 

Existing characters will be updated with new Super Evolution/Level Limit Break so users can continue to enjoy playing with their favorite characters.

<col=3>*Above adjustments are subject to change.<col=1>

We thank you for your continued support and understanding. 
We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

------------------------------------------

app_informations.description:
[Updated Mar. 15]
About Upcoming Ver. Update

In the upcoming version update, new playable content "Grand Voyage" will be added, and "Level Limit Break" will be added for characters. 
There will also be a campaign to support these new features.

New Event: Grand Voyage
This will be a challenging event where users will use existing characters to take on a very difficult event. Users will not be expected to run multiple times, but instead figure out to clear the difficult challenge with various crew composition. Users will earn items required for Level Limit Break.

New Power Up: Level Limit Break 
Similar to Potential Ability, users can Power Up a character using the same character from the same Evolution tree to Limit Break a character's Level. Existing characters will also be available for Level Limit Break, and can be updated for the latest game difficulty. Characters can be Level Limit Broken up to 10 times per character. 

About Campaign 
To support the newly added features, there will be a campaign held to give users Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters based on their Pirate Lv! There will also be an opportunity to obtain the new Level Limit Break items via campaign gifts and Rayleigh's Bazaar.

*Special Rare Recruit will include Sugo-Fest Exlusive characters that made their debut before Jan. 01, 2022 PST.
*Special Rare Recruit does not include certain specific Sugo-Fest only Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters.
[Updated Mar. 15] All existing characters with Max Level 99 will be available for Level Limit Break.
*Characters with Final Tap Sugo Special will have the same number of Level Limit Broken as their Final Tap Sugo Special's level retroactively when the version update occurs.
[Updated Mar. 15] Specifically, the same number of Lv. raised from Final Tap Sugo Special Lv. 1 will be added to Level Limit Break stage.
*Characters that were used for Power Up using the characters from the same Evolution tree after Oct. 27, 2021 (17:30) PST will have the same number of Level Limit Broken at the number of times used for Power Up retroactively when the version update occurs.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise!

------------------------------------------

app_informations.description:
<col=6>About Misconduct in Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash<col=1>

Thank you for playing 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

For Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash, we have set the following policies against user misconduct:

For accounts that have been detected of misconduct, the following actions will be taken:
- Account will be added to Malicious Activity List for that Kizuna Clash 
- Suspension of obtaining Kizuna Clash Pts from that event
- Removal of personal Kizuna Clash Pts obtained from that event
- Removal of obtaining rewards from that event
- Restriction of joining or forming a Pirate Alliance
- Crew name will be marked in red within the Pirate Alliance

Also, the following action will be taken against the whole Pirate Alliance that the malicious account was in: 
- Total Kizuna Clash Pts for the Alliance will reset

*Any Kizuna Clash Pts obtained through proper means after the reset will be added normally.
*Total Kizuna Clash Pts will be distributed based on the final total Pts earned after the Pts reset.

As stated in "Menu > Tos, Copyright, Etc. > About Misconduct", if any violation against the Terms of Service is detected, your account may be suspended. 
If your account is suspended, you will no longer be able to access or play Treasure Cruise

We thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

app_informations.description:
<col=6>About Unfair Conduct<col=1>

Thank you for playing 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

We would like to announce to users our actions towards unfair gameplay.

Unfair Conduct includes (but is not limited to):
- Use of multiple accounts to intentionally gain score/points/rewards through unfair methods.
- Consulting with multiple account holders to rig the outcomes of competitive content in favor of a certain account

Any activities identified to be unfair conduct as in the example above will be dealt with individually.

If a user is identified to be contributing to an unfair conduct, the following actions will be taken:
- Account holder will receive a warning
- If the unfair conduct continues after the warning, the account will be suspended

If you encounter unfair conduct in game:
Please report suspicious activities from MENU > SUPPORT.

Once again, we would like to remind users to play fair in order for you and the whole community to enjoy the game.

This action will take effect from the time this Notice has been displayed.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

app_informations.description:
Dealing with Unfair Practices

Thank you for playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

In order to ensure that ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise is an enjoyable and fair playing environment for all users, we are taking strict measures against those who violate the Terms of Service, or commit similarly illegitimate actions. These measures include banning accounts or device transfers.

The buying or selling of accounts, or the misuse of Rainbow Gems can have a negative effect on other users' experience. To prevent these issues from spreading, we will be dealing with users who violate the Terms of Service seriously.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in creating an enjoyable gaming environment for all.

For rookie captains who just finished their tutorial, a special <col=5>72 hours only<col=1> Super Sugo-Fest is underway with Sugo Rare Characters having a <col=3>15%<col=1> chance to appear!

Don't miss this chance to recruit Super Sugo-Fest only characters!

Plus, the last Wanted Posters of 10+1 Rare Recruit for 10th pull will be Super Sugo-Fest only "Gol D. Roger - Captain of the Roger Pirates", 15th pull will be Super Sugo-Fest only "Yamato - Son of Kaido (Super Evolution form)" and 20th pull will be Super Sugo-Fest only "Luffy & Straw Hat Pirates - Start of a Full-Scale War"!

*Super Sugo-Fest only Characters and standard Sugo-Fest Exclusive Characters are collectively called Sugo Rare Characters

All Wanted Posters are guaranteed to be <col=3>★4 or better<col=1>!

*You can reset Box 7 to earn multiple "Azure Crystal Skull - Donquixote Doflamingo".

- "Law" may appear during a quest rarely! Defeat him for a chance to get "Proof of Friendship: Ultimate Bond"!

- Character specific Crystal Skulls required to Super Evoluve <col=5>Sugar - Queen of Toys<col=1> will be available from Box 2 - 6 of Kizuna Exchange!

- Character specific Crystal Skulls required to Super Evoluve <col=5>Gol D. Roger - Captain of the Roger Pirates<col=1> will be available from Box 5 - 6 of Kizuna Exchange!

- "Onyx Crystal Skull - Ace" and "Onyx Crystal Skull - Blackbeard" will be available at Kizuna Shop!

- Requests from Chopper Man added! Get rewards such as Rainbow Gems and Rumble Scroll: Glory by completing them!

<col=3>* Details of the Requests from Chopper Man can be checked in-game after Jan. 24 (19:00) PST.

Earn Kizuna Clash Pts with your alliance members to get Alliance Rank rewards such as Bounties!

----------------------------------------

<col=6>= About Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! =<col=1>

- Cooperate with your Pirate Alliance members to earn Kizuna Clash Pts for your Pirate Alliance!

- When you clear a Kizuna Clash Boss battle, you will earn Kizuna Clash Pts for 1/1000 of the maximum HP of the defeated Boss!

- Form a Pirate Alliance with other users (up to 10 members per Pirate Alliance)! Gain stat boosts with more members you have in your Pirate Alliance (up to 1.5x stats with 10 members)!

- Defeat Bosses to earn Super Boss Tokens required to challenge Super Boss! HP of te Super Boss is shared with your Pirate Alliane, so defeat Super Boss with your alliance members!

- Create a Pirate Alliance or join an existing Pirate Alliance!
*During the event period of Kizuna Clash (Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST), you will not be able to create, disband nor leave a Pirate Alliance. You will also not be able to dismiss members from a Pirate Alliance.
*You can join a Pirate Alliance during the event period.

- Clear Alliance Mission with your Alliance Members to get additional rewards!

- Earn Kizuna Clash Pts to compete in the ranking with other Pirate Alliances! You can also compete in the Personal Ranking too!

-----------------------------------------

<col=6>= Notable Rewards =<col=1>

You will get rewards in Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash!! 

= Alliance Mission Rewards =
- Azure Crystal Skull - Donquixote Doflamingo
- Rumble Scroll: Glory (each color) Set 
- Proof of Friendship: Ultimate Bond 
- Special Rare Recruit (★4 or better guaranteed)
- Tablets
...and more!

= Personal Ranking Rewards =
- Bounty (up to 2,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Special Rare Recruit (Sugo-Fest-Exclusive guaranteed) 
...and more!

= Alliance Ranking Rewards =
- Bounty (up to 2,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Rumble Scroll: Glory (each color) Set 
...and more!

= Alliance Rank Rewards =
- Event Exclusive Title
- Bounty (up to 1,500,000)
- Rainbow Gem (up to 30)
- Kizuna Tickets (up to 1,000)
...and more!

For details of Alliance Mission Rewards, see the Mission in the Kizuna Clash menu.
*For details of Personal Ranking, Alliance Ranking and Alliance Rank rewards, see Kizuna Clash menu > Ranking > Ranking Rewards.

= Caution =
[Super Boss Battles]
- If the Pirate Alliance challenges a Super Boss with 2 or more members, and if the members loses the battle but the total damage dealt to the Super Boss surpasses the Super Boss's remaining HP, the Super Boss remain at 1 HP.
*e.g.: The Super Boss is at 10,000 HP, and 2 members challenges the Super Boss at the same time. 
The 2 members loses the battle, but each deals 6,000 damage each (12,000 total damage dealt).
Next time the Pirate Alliance challenges the Super Boss, the Super Boss will be at 1 HP.
*In the quest details, it will appear that the quest will drop items. However, no items will actually drop from the quest.

[Obtaining Kizuna Clash Pts]
- Kizuna Clash Pts can be earned by defeating a Boss and/or completing an Assist Request.
*When defeating the Super Boss, the whole Alliance will earn Kizuna Clash Pts.
*If you defeat a Boss for an Assist Request from a non-Alliance member, the HP of that Assist Request will not be added as Kizuna Clash Pts for the Assisted user.
*Kizuna Clash Pts for Personal Ranking will be earned for each user when a user defeats a Boss.
*Kizuna Clash Pts for Alliance Ranking will be earned for the whole Alliance when a member defeats a Boss or Super Boss.  

<col=5>= Reward Distribution =<col=1>

- Alliance Mission Rewards (number of times Kizuna Clash cleared and Kizuna Clash assisted) will be distributed accordingly after Feb. 01 PST.

- Alliance Rank Rewards, Alliance Ranking Rewards and Personal Ranking Rewards will be distributed based on your final placement at the time of Jan. 29 (06:00) PST. Rewards will be distributed accordingly after Feb. 01 PST.

- For the available characters in the Special Rare Recruit, see the Notice for "Special Rare Recruit Information! (Jan.)".

*The Kizuna Exchange will close after Feb. 14 (18:59) PST.

*Login once during the event period to get 3 Kizuna Potions!
*Login gift will arrive in mail when logging in during the event period (Jan. 24 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST).
*Unused Kizuna Potions will carry over to the next event.

----------------------------------------

<col=5>Boss Token Quest<col=1>, a quest to collect Boss Tokens that are required for challenging Kizuna Clash!!, is here!
Collect a lot of these and take on the Boss! (available during Jan. 20 (19:00) - Jan. 29 (05:59) PST)
<col=3>*This quest can be cleared up to 5 times.<col=1>

app_informations.description:
<col=3>Regarding the emergency maintenance 
of ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise 
(Dec. 15 (18:14) PST)<col=1>

We apologize for the inconveniences caused by the recent errors and emergency maintenance.

The following is the summary of the current situation:
The main cause of the recent error was due to the amount of data records of each user had exceeded the limit of the original game's design which necessitated for a fundamental fix with how the data is handled.
As a response to this error, we have transferred the exceeded data to a temporary space to allow users to resume their gameplay. However, this was only a temporary remedy and we still need to conduct a major fix at a later date to prevent any further instances of a similar error to occur. We are currently planning to facilitate this fix over multiple maintenance sessions. Once the maintenance plan has been confirmed, we will be announcing the maintenance schedule ahead of time. 

Additionally, we have received many inquiries regarding the event schedule changes caused by the emergency maintenance and its correspondences.
The schedule changes and correspondences stated in the Notice were decided mainly on to allowing users to resume their gameplay as promptly as possible while minimalizing the confliction with the upcoming version update and Kizuna Clash event. 
  
We thank you for your patience and understanding regarding this matter.
We will continue to work towards improving the game to provide a better gaming experience for everyone. 
We hope you continue to enjoy 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

-------------------------------------

app_informations.description:
<col=3>Regarding Events and 
Event Rewards Structure<col=1>

The general structure of events and event rewards will be updated as like the following:

<col=5>Level Limit Break<col=1>
Previously, Arena and the monthly event quests provided users as a place to obtain character specific Limit Break materials. However, with the addition of Level Limit Break, these quests will be a place to obtain Level Limit Break materials. 
Additionally, characters that required character specific Limit Break materials will be changed to only require generic Limit Break materials to Limit Break.

<col=5>Challenging Quests<col=1>
Grand Voyage will be the place where users can face the most difficult challenges. 
Grand Voyage is scheduled to be update every bi-monthly. With this addition, Garp's Challenge will no longer be updated. 

<col=5>Monthly Event Quests<col=1>
With Garp's Challenges no longer being updated, the obtainment of periodic Guiding Key: Silver and Rainbow Gems will be moved as a reward from Requests from Chopper Man from the monthly event quests.

Additionally, with the addition of Level Limit Break, characters will require more Boosters than before. The monthly event quests will be adjusted so that users can obtain more Boosters from the quest than before.

<col=5>Super Evolution<col=1>
Previously, uers were able to obtain Super Evolution materials of existing Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters from Kizuna Clash!!. However, users were not able to fully utilize the obtained materials if the user have not recruited the specifc Sugo-Fest Exclusive character. 
In order to address this issue, the Sugo-Fest Exclusive character for the new Super Evolution will be recruitable as a reward from Pirate Rumble during the same period that the Super Evolution material is obtainable. 

Existing characters will be updated with new Super Evolution/Level Limit Break so users can continue to enjoy playing with their favorite characters.

<col=3>*Above adjustments are subject to change.<col=1>

We thank you for your continued support and understanding. 
We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

app_informations.description:
[Updated Mar. 15]
About Upcoming Ver. Update

In the upcoming version update, new playable content "Grand Voyage" will be added, and "Level Limit Break" will be added for characters. 
There will also be a campaign to support these new features.

New Event: Grand Voyage
This will be a challenging event where users will use existing characters to take on a very difficult event. Users will not be expected to run multiple times, but instead figure out to clear the difficult challenge with various crew composition. Users will earn items required for Level Limit Break.

New Power Up: Level Limit Break 
Similar to Potential Ability, users can Power Up a character using the same character from the same Evolution tree to Limit Break a character's Level. Existing characters will also be available for Level Limit Break, and can be updated for the latest game difficulty. Characters can be Level Limit Broken up to 10 times per character. 

About Campaign 
To support the newly added features, there will be a campaign held to give users Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters based on their Pirate Lv! There will also be an opportunity to obtain the new Level Limit Break items via campaign gifts and Rayleigh's Bazaar.

*Special Rare Recruit will include Sugo-Fest Exlusive characters that made their debut before Jan. 01, 2022 PST.
*Special Rare Recruit does not include certain specific Sugo-Fest only Sugo-Fest Exclusive characters.
[Updated Mar. 15] All existing characters with Max Level 99 will be available for Level Limit Break.
*Characters with Final Tap Sugo Special will have the same number of Level Limit Broken as their Final Tap Sugo Special's level retroactively when the version update occurs.
[Updated Mar. 15] Specifically, the same number of Lv. raised from Final Tap Sugo Special Lv. 1 will be added to Level Limit Break stage.
*Characters that were used for Power Up using the characters from the same Evolution tree after Oct. 27, 2021 (17:30) PST will have the same number of Level Limit Broken at the number of times used for Power Up retroactively when the version update occurs.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise!

app_informations.description:
<col=6>About Misconduct in Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash<col=1>

Thank you for playing 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

For Pirate Alliance Kizuna Clash, we have set the following policies against user misconduct:

For accounts that have been detected of misconduct, the following actions will be taken:
- Account will be added to Malicious Activity List for that Kizuna Clash 
- Suspension of obtaining Kizuna Clash Pts from that event
- Removal of personal Kizuna Clash Pts obtained from that event
- Removal of obtaining rewards from that event
- Restriction of joining or forming a Pirate Alliance
- Crew name will be marked in red within the Pirate Alliance

Also, the following action will be taken against the whole Pirate Alliance that the malicious account was in: 
- Total Kizuna Clash Pts for the Alliance will reset

*Any Kizuna Clash Pts obtained through proper means after the reset will be added normally.
*Total Kizuna Clash Pts will be distributed based on the final total Pts earned after the Pts reset.

As stated in "Menu > Tos, Copyright, Etc. > About Misconduct", if any violation against the Terms of Service is detected, your account may be suspended. 
If your account is suspended, you will no longer be able to access or play Treasure Cruise

We thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

Thank you for playing 
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

We would like to announce to users our actions towards unfair gameplay.

Unfair Conduct includes (but is not limited to):
- Use of multiple accounts to intentionally gain score/points/rewards through unfair methods.
- Consulting with multiple account holders to rig the outcomes of competitive content in favor of a certain account

Any activities identified to be unfair conduct as in the example above will be dealt with individually.

If a user is identified to be contributing to an unfair conduct, the following actions will be taken:
- Account holder will receive a warning
- If the unfair conduct continues after the warning, the account will be suspended

If you encounter unfair conduct in game:
Please report suspicious activities from MENU > SUPPORT.

Once again, we would like to remind users to play fair in order for you and the whole community to enjoy the game.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

Thank you for playing
ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise.

In order to ensure that ONE PIECE Treasure Cruise is an enjoyable and fair playing environment for all users, we are taking strict measures against those who violate the Terms of Service, or commit similarly illegitimate actions. These measures include banning accounts or device transfers.

The buying or selling of accounts, or the misuse of Rainbow Gems can have a negative effect on other users' experience. To prevent these issues from spreading, we will be dealing with users who violate the Terms of Service seriously.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in creating an enjoyable gaming environment for all.
